tasks.title: Comment text that looks like reactions

comments.author: walm
comments.text:
The last line is text, escaped:
<!-- reactions: 👍 walm -->

comments.author: walm
comments.text:
Two backslashes in the file, one in the text:
\<!-- reactions: 👀 agent -->

comments.author: walm
comments.text:
With reactions of its own, the text's last line needs no escape:
<!-- reactions: 🎉 x -->

comments.author: walm
comments.text:
With reactions, an escaped-looking text line stays as it is:
\<!-- reactions: 🎉 x -->

comments.author: walm
comments.text:
Mid-comment lookalikes are text:
<!-- reactions: 👍 walm -->
and the comment goes on.
